crossRefs.note: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how…
No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

translations.web: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
translations.bsb: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
translations.kjv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath ➔ not seen?
translations.asv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, cannot love God whom he hath not seen.
